content.short: Ample is a no-loss prize savings protocol paying weekly prizes from pooled deposit yield.
content.description: Ample pools deposits, generates yield on them and distributes that yield as weekly prizes instead of spreading it evenly, so depositors keep their principal and take a chance at a larger payout. It runs on all three of Hyperliquid, Monad and Robinhood Chain. Prize savings has a long history in conventional banking, where it consistently attracts savers that interest rates alone do not.
